text: ③いれかえたい　ポケモンを　えらぶと　ならびかえ　できます。

structure.jp: ③いれかえたい　ポケモンを
structure.en: ③ the Pokémon you want to swap with

structure.jp: ならびかえ　できます。

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that when this is done, the next thing follows every time. えらぶと = 'when you select it'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says you want to do it. いれかえたい　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you want to swap in'.

patterns.name: 〜できる
patterns.span: ならびかえ　できます
patterns.explanation: できる after an action word says that action can be done. ならびかえ　できます = 'you can reorder'.
